stateaware_role: Ablation only; no new state-aware methods; historical Phase-D statistics quarantined pending correctness repair. STOP expansion preserved, but no claim of proven ineffectiveness.
primary_questions: Does actually executed node-level DAG outperform whole-query Dynamic?
How do Q, Q+T, and Q+C+T+R change the preferred routing granularity?
resource_normalization_status: Must freeze shared end-to-end units and scales before unified policy training; never per-regime normalize. Historical clipped normalization cannot be silently changed or mixed.

regimes.Static: One model per objective selected only on development/training groups, one full-task call.
regimes.Dynamic: Request-only predictor chooses one model per task and objective, one full-task call.
regimes.DAG: Request features + node + candidate model; no runtime state. Execute N1->N2->N3->N4 with real upstream outputs, one model decision per node.

metric_contract.Q: Same final-answer scorer and delivery-validity contract across regimes; deterministic and machine-judged strata reported separately.
metric_contract.C: Total end-to-end billed inference cost including failed attempts/retries and router overhead where applicable. Scorer costs accounted separately.
metric_contract.T: Actual end-to-end workflow time including retries/backoff and routing; N1->N4 is a chain, not diamond-parallel latency. Queue/service diagnostics retained.
metric_contract.R: One common objective delivery-validity predicate; not Q threshold, not a mean of node reliabilities.

scorer: Reuse current frozen numeric scorer and disclosed Qwen-Max machine endpoint only after common interface applicability audit; no human-validation claim.
fairness_requirements: Same evaluation tasks, source context, model versions/providers, budgets, timeout/retry policy, and final response interface.
Shared grouped training/validation partitions across objectives/regimes.
Do not treat 3 historical whole-query repeats and 4 exploration DAG paths as paired repeats of learned policies.
Deduplicate actual execution only when complete prompt/model/settings/upstream-history hashes match; retain paired metric accounting.
No synthetic counterfactual node outputs or DR estimate presented as realized full-DAG quality.
main_table: For each optimization target, one table of Static/Dynamic/DAG with Q, cost, end-to-end latency, R, Q+T utility and Q+C+T+R utility. Optimization target and reported metrics explicitly distinguished.
uncertainty: Paired leakage-group bootstrap for actual executed arms; prespecify repeat aggregation and multiplicity across the three targets before confirmatory labels.
holdout: Freeze learned policies and full execution manifest first; audit prior exposure and leakage groups before treating any existing internal holdout as fresh. No holdout outcomes accessed at this stage.
pre_execution_gates: Common final-answer delivery contract and inference settings are not yet shared between historical whole-query and DAG execution.
DAG full-policy outcome must be obtained by actual execution; cannot splice outcomes from incompatible upstream histories.
Objective-specific policy artifacts and paired execution manifest must be frozen before final validation.
Internal holdout freshness needs lineage/leakage-group audit; do not assume the named 20-task holdout is fresh across all historical training.
execution_order: Finalize common interface, metric normalization, and lineage audit.
Produce shared-scored development matrices and freeze the three-objective policy bank.
Build and validate paired real-execution manifest.
Execute unified comparison; no post-result retuning.
Freeze independent holdout validation; report all objectives and failures.
explicitly_not_authorized_by_this_file: Treat StateAware GO gate as prerequisite to the restored paper mainline
Claim E5 completed from historical incomparable tables
